_comment: Every on-chain program observed executing in a presale transaction, including CPI targets. Regenerate with `npm run programs:baseline` after a full lifecycle run; `npm run programs:inventory` FAILS on anything not listed here. Package-level SCA cannot produce this list — a CPI target is not a dependency. Upgrade authorities below were read from mainnet-beta on 2026-07-26, because that is the cluster whose answer matters; a devnet deployment can differ.
_measuredOn: mainnet-beta (authorities) / local validator cloned from devnet (invocations)

GNS1S5J5AspKXgpjz6SvKL66kPaKWAhaGRhCqPRx.name: Metaplex Genesis
GNS1S5J5AspKXgpjz6SvKL66kPaKWAhaGRhCqPRx.mutability: UPGRADEABLE — the only mutable program in the money path
GNS1S5J5AspKXgpjz6SvKL66kPaKWAhaGRhCqPRx.note: THE trust assumption of this sale. Genesis custodies the entire raise, the vesting schedules and the never-claim LP lock, and its bytecode can be replaced by the authority above at any time, without any change to this repository. That authority is OFF-CURVE, so it is a PDA rather than a bare keypair (consistent with a Squads-style multisig vault); the signer threshold is not observable from here and is not something this project controls. Measured on mainnet-beta 2026-07-26.
